prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four-panel café illustration sprite for a teaching website.
Create a new photorealistic, refined café editorial still life as one LANDSCAPE 1536×1024 pixel contact sheet. Exactly FOUR equal rectangular 768×512 panels arranged in an exact 2×2 grid, edge to edge with no gutter, dividing line, margin, border or UI. Absolutely no words, labels, headings, lettering, logo, watermark or typography.
Reference image 1 (Flat screenshot) is ONLY a subject/composition reference. Reference image 2 (Glass screenshot) is ONLY a reference for cool cyan/lavender ambient light and subtly frosted BACKGROUND surfaces. Do NOT recreate any website, screenshot or interface. The transparent croissants in reference 2 are an ERROR: never make pastry, cup or plate glass.
Canonical panel content and reading order:
TOP LEFT: a café tabletop scene at a three-quarter overhead angle. Exactly ONE white opaque CERAMIC espresso cup filled with brown coffee and its white opaque ceramic saucer in the FRONT LEFT, exactly ONE ordinary golden baked OPAQUE croissant on a white opaque ceramic plate at the BACK RIGHT, and one folded ivory cloth napkin at the LOWER RIGHT. All cup, handle, saucer, pastry and plate completely visible. Napkin can touch the right edge as in the reference. No extra food, cups or drinks.
TOP RIGHT: exactly ONE normal white opaque CERAMIC espresso cup filled with brown coffee, visible handle at right, with its white opaque ceramic saucer. Centered isolated product.
BOTTOM LEFT: exactly ONE natural golden baked OPAQUE croissant. Real appetizing laminated dough, crisp buttery flaky brown crust, ordinary solid bread, absolutely not glass, jelly, crystal, chrome or see-through. Centered isolated product, no plate or other food.
BOTTOM RIGHT: exactly ONE ordinary clear glass tea cup with visible handle at right and amber tea inside. This tea cup alone is truly transparent glass as normal in the real world. Centered isolated product.
Style and materials: calm high-end café product photography, photoreal real human objects, natural believable shapes and perspective. SHARP coffee, real white ceramics and golden bread. Subtle cool cyan/lavender ambient illumination on quiet very pale tabletop surfaces. A faint MATTE FROSTED TRANSLUCENT pane or soft blur/reflection may appear only in the background behind the objects. Environmental glass must never transform the food or opaque ceramic cups/plates. Subdued soft light, gentle physically plausible shadows, no rainbow CGI bling, giant glass lenses, shiny chromed surfaces, fantasy holograms or overpowering caustics. Warm golden croissant and warm brown coffee remain natural despite cool light.
Keep quantities exact and the composition of the four slots constant. Allow at least 8% safe margin around every product, with all handles and saucers fully visible, and comparable product scale in the three individual product panels. All panels must stay recognizable, quiet and crop-ready.
referenceRoles: luce fredda e materiali dello sfondo Glass
revisionPurpose: Correggere il croissant erroneamente trasparente nel raster Glass originale: vetro e traslucenza riguardano ambiente e superfici di interfaccia, mentre croissant e ceramica restano fisicamente opachi.

qa.quadrants: esattamente quattro pannelli rettangolari uguali 2×2 senza gutter o testi
qa.hero: un espresso in ceramica bianca con piattino davanti a sinistra; un croissant cotto opaco su piatto di ceramica bianca dietro a destra; tovagliolo piegato in basso a destra
qa.espresso: una tazzina opaca bianca in ceramica con caffè e piattino interamente visibile
qa.croissant: un croissant dorato cotto opaco interamente visibile, nessuna trasparenza o artefatto vetroso
qa.te: una tazza normale di vetro con tè ambrato e manico visibile
qa.composition: prodotti e manici interi; tovagliolo arriva al bordo destro come nel riferimento
qa.materials: ceramica e impasto opachi; luce ciano/lavanda e riflessi delicati solo nell'ambiente
qa.visualInspection: confermata sul raster originale e sulla copia finale
